# Seven Layers

> We build beautiful websites and grow your business online. Web development, Shopify stores, SEO, and digital marketing for small businesses and startups.

Remote-first studio. Prices are published in GBP, starting from £999 for a brochure website. Every site is designed to WCAG 2.2 AA. Written in British English.

- [Should you let AI crawlers read your website?](https://www.sevenlayers.online/blog/should-you-let-ai-crawlers-read-your-site): There are three kinds of AI crawler, and blocking the wrong one quietly removes you from AI answers. What each does, and the setting that may have changed.

- [Deepfake fraud: the cheap defences that actually work](https://www.sevenlayers.online/blog/deepfake-fraud-small-business-defences): A convincing fake voice now takes seconds of audio. The defences are old-fashioned and nearly free: callbacks, a change-of-bank-details rule, and time.
